changes.text: Optimized Contact Form slider performance by converting high-frequency Framer Motion layout animations into GPU-accelerated CSS 3D transforms with 'will-change' rendering optimizations.
Fixed layout flickering and viewport transition bugs on app start by streamlining the Intro Loader lifecycle and pointer-event states.
Corrected architecture diagram links in the Projects Section to ensure proper asset rendering and prevent broken images.
Enhanced responsive layout rendering by restructuring layout containers and ensuring global scrollbar hiding utility rules use high-priority overrides.
Implemented an infinite ticker-tape style logo carousel in the About section to showcase relevant tech stack and partner logos.
Added a comprehensive, production-grade README.md for project documentation and setup.
Corrected multiple TypeScript type errors across components and hooks (Framer Motion variants, React refs).
Resolved a bug in the sound hook that prevented toggling sound effects and fixed corrupted audio data strings.
Strengthened code quality and stability by addressing numerous minor bugs and type inconsistencies throughout the codebase.
Refined footer layout, relocating attribution and tech stack for better organization.
Integrated a 'Coffee Intake' live counter to the footer statistics.
Enhanced footer title and description for clarity (Portfolio > Aetherius OS).
Updated copyright notice to include 'All Rights Reserved'.
Increased visibility of the footer's gradient divider line.
Overhauled footer into a dynamic, three-column 'live document' layout.
Integrated a 'Live Status' panel in the footer with animated statistics.
Redesigned 'Back to Top' button with a scroll progress indicator and context-aware visibility.
Major Feature: Redesigned Experience section with an interactive dossier modal (v6), including impact metrics, operational snapshots, and contextual skill tooltips.
Major Feature: Upgraded project dossier modal (v5) with an enhanced custom video player, media switcher for architecture diagrams, and floating action buttons.
Added Project Dock navigation for quick access to projects when the section is in view.
Redesigned Education section into a unified hub with timeline, interactive certification carousel, and holographic roadmap for future plans.
Contact form upgraded to 'macOS style' with floating labels, validation, and a client-side Proof-of-Work to deter bots.
Integrated 'Direct Relays' accordion in Contact section for quick access to email and LinkedIn.
Major UI Overhaul: Launched the new 'Aetherius OS' theme, transforming the site into a simulated operating system experience.
Added interactive CyberSec Dashboard in the About section, featuring a draggable window and a live skill profiler.
Implemented the system bootloader sequence on initial site load for a thematic entry experience.
Created a comprehensive settings panel to control theme, accent colors, and toggle visual effects like CRT lines, firewall glow, and glitch animations.
Initial Launch: Portfolio website goes live.
Core sections established: Hero, About, Experience, Projects, Education, and Contact.
Implemented a responsive design for desktop and mobile devices.
